objectives.text: Tell Ines Park what you saw. She is at the bar.
On the next audit night, deal it straight. Ines Park is watching Halloran.
Photograph the ledger on the pit stand for Ines Park.
Someone is waiting for you at the bar.

i_0.speaker: Ines Park
i_0.text: Don't look around. Ines Park, state gaming enforcement. Halloran runs money through these tables, and I can't prove it from the bar. There's a ledger on the pit stand. I need pictures of it. You're the only one who can get close.

choices.text: I'll see what I can do.
You're going to get me killed.

i_need.speaker: Ines Park
i_need.text: The ledger on the pit stand. Photograph it when Halloran isn't looking at you. He is always looking, so pick your moment.

i_1.speaker: Ines Park
i_1.text: Let me see. ...These are payouts on hands that were never dealt. He's washing money through the tables and signing for it. This is good. It isn't enough.

choices.text: He also has me dealing wins to a man named Castellano.

i_cast.speaker: Ines Park
i_cast.text: Castellano. That's the name I've been missing. You just made yourself very useful, and a little safer. I'll have a word with the camera room about how closely they watch you.

i_wait.speaker: Ines Park
i_wait.text: There's an audit coming. When the auditors are on the floor, deal your table straight. Not one stacked card. I'll be watching who Halloran signals when the money stops moving.

i_2.speaker: Ines Park
i_2.text: You dealt it clean and he flinched at every hand. I saw who he called. That's my case. In return: a detective I know has had a quiet word with your friend Sal. You have two more nights on your payment, and the camera room has lost interest in you for now.

i_done.speaker: Ines Park
i_done.text: Keep your head down and keep dealing. When I move on Halloran, you'll know.

x_sold.speaker: Mr. Halloran
x_sold.text: Is there. ...Sit down. No, you did right. She'll be gone by morning, and nobody will ask where. Three thousand off your tab. You and I understand each other now.
